description: Plays one of nine bytebeat equations, an integer expression over a running time counter heard as audio

params.text: Sets how many samples pass before the time counter advances, from none up to 256, and a longer division lowers the pitch
Picks which of the nine equations is heard
Sets the value of that parameter in the equation, a whole number from 0 to 128
Attenuates the CV for that parameter, from nothing through to its full range

inputs.text: Adds to that parameter after its attenuator, 0-10V covering the full 0 to 128
Adds to the equation choice, the nine equations spread over 0-10V
Adds to the sample division that sets the pitch, its full range over 0-10V

outputs.text: The audio the equation makes, -5V to 5V

notes: the equation runs on the module's own counter, so the output makes sound with nothing patched in
